summary.headline: H1 FY27 total income rose 74% YoY to Rs.70.06 crore and net profit 29% to Rs.9.71 crore; management targets Rs.150 crore FY27 revenue (±10%).
summary.overview: H1 FY27 total income was Rs.70.06 crore (+74% YoY), net profit Rs.9.71 crore (+29%) and EBITDA Rs.14.63 crore vs Rs.11.71 crore a year earlier. Management said margins fell short of guidance in H1 because paper prices rose and marketing spend was front-loaded, and it expects H2 to average out to the 14-16% PAT range. The company is expanding into in-house notebooks (PageCraft), a school supplies bundle (Pelican EduSupply), interactive panels via Wiki Kids, and acquiring Hara Communications' land and assets for Rs.10-15 crore. Operating cash flow was negative again in H1, with management targeting positive full-year operating cash flow.

segments.name: Publishing (textbooks)
segments.commentary: Core business, serving schools across 13 states; Northeast business started in Q3 and Maharashtra/West Bengal expected in Q4. Management said textbook receivables are cyclical.

segments.name: Notebooks / PageCraft
segments.commentary: In-house notebook manufacturing using newly acquired machinery; expected turnover Rs.20-25 crore from converting existing traded notebook sales. Traded notebook gross margin about 67% vs about 12% expected for PageCraft.

segments.name: E-commerce / Pelican EduSupply
segments.commentary: About 50 schools and Rs.25 crore turnover last year; about 100 schools onboarded this year with turnover expected around Rs.50 crore. PAT below 10% because 40% of product is traded.

segments.name: Interactive panels (Wiki Kids)
segments.commentary: Sole India distribution for Wiki Kids IFP panels with about 10% margin per panel; currently a pilot with no revenue guidance until next year.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue target around Rs.150 crore, plus or minus 10%.
Full-year PAT margin guided at 14-16%; management said it expects to achieve 14-15%, possibly higher.
Management expects H2 (Q3 and Q4) to offset H1 margin pressure as marketing spend declines and sales peak.
Management expects positive operating cash flow for FY27.
MRP to be raised around 10% to offset paper cost increase.
capex_capacity: Hara Communications Pvt Ltd acquisition: asset-based deal, outgo around Rs.10-15 crore including land and premises; share swap and consolidation expected by December 2026. Hara has losses of about Rs.40-50 lakh.
Rs.7-8 crore bank loan planned to fund part of the Hara acquisition, with the balance from receivables.
Notebook manufacturing capacity of about Rs.30-40 crore of turnover on current machinery; more machinery may be needed beyond that.
Stationery capacity utilisation at 60-70%; white-labelling Chinese stationery planned once in-house capacity reaches 100%.
E-commerce capped at about 100 schools due to warehouse and packing capacity.
demand_pricing: Paper: about 90% of raw material for the season bought at Rs.78-81/kg equivalent (as stated); spot price cited at about Rs.93, with management expecting about Rs.100 for the remaining 10% purchased later.
Management attributed H1 margin pressure mainly to paper cost rises linked to the war and marketing spend.
Army school repeat orders and Northeast demand boosted H2-to-date sales.
Competition: Navneet and Chetana cited; management said Chetana has about 90% Maharashtra concentration and Navneet has guides and college books, so direct comparison is limited.
Pelican e-commerce: 100 schools tied up; management said these count toward the coming academic year rather than FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Why were margins below guidance in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited paper price volatility linked to the war and higher marketing and sales spend, and said H1 averages out with Q3 and Q4.

qa_highlights.question: What is FY27 and FY28 revenue target?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 around Rs.150 crore plus or minus 10%; FY28 Rs.225-230 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Will operating cash flow be positive for the full year?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said that is the aim, citing cash discounts to customers to speed collections and lower raw material and marketing spend in H2.

qa_highlights.question: What is the debt outlook for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Current debt is Rs.14-16 crore on EMI; a Rs.7-8 crore bank loan is planned for the Hara acquisition; no bulk prepayment planned.

qa_highlights.question: How much of receivables are over six months old?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about 20% of the Rs.9 crore long-credit institutional order is outstanding and only about Rs.5-6 crore of total receivables is over six months.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Pelican/PageCraft margin and revenue impact?
qa_highlights.answer: Traded notebook margin was about 67%, PageCraft expected around 12%; PageCraft expected to add Rs.20-25 crore and largely shift existing traded sales in-house.

risks_watch: Margin delivery depends on H2 sales and on the remaining 10% of paper bought at higher prices (management estimated about Rs.100).
Receivables are high and the company did not confirm the closing figure on the call; a follow-up was promised but not provided.
Operating cash flow was negative in H1 and must turn positive for the full year.
Hara Communications acquisition: completion, share swap and integration are pending; its software was described as not necessary.
PageCraft and panel rollout execution, including delivery timelines and service issues for hardware.
Management said Harish Dachepalli's remarks on the Rs.95 lakh loan were that it was already repaid; the analyst's question on the loan was not fully clarified in the transcript.
summary.management_tone: Confident on top-line growth and the FY27 targets, but defensive on margins and receivables; several answers were repetitive or loose on numbers (for example, receivables and Hara's losses), and management repeatedly deferred precise figures to later follow-ups.
